Title: LSJ: charming lobby+PA cards with cost

Messages.Author: talonz
Messages.Body:
Charming lobby is the action played, naming a referendum on a PA card
in hand with a cost.

As charming lobby has no cost, is the cost of the PA card bypassed?

If yes, and the cost of the PA card is X, is there an opportunity to
set X at all (as costs are normally set and announced at action start)?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Aug 19, 5:18 pm, talonz <talon...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> Charming lobby is the action played, naming a referendum on a PA card
> in hand with a cost.

"(play that card)"

> As charming lobby has no cost, is the cost of the PA card bypassed?

No. The PA card is played, meaning that requirements and cost apply as
normal.

> If yes, and the cost of the PA card is X, is there an opportunity to
> set X at all (as costs are normally set and announced at action start)?

X is set (and paid) when the PA card is played.
